conclusions_zh: 在峰值高度 H=1.8000 u、半宽 w=0.25 u 的陡峭山脊掠射轮廓测试中，固定步长视差遮挡步进（POM Δx=0.40 u）因采样点 x∈{−0.20, +0.20} u 跨过 x=0.00 u 峰顶，导致 y∈[1.00, 1.80] u 的 9/17 条视线全部穿峰漏检（有效轮廓坍缩至 0.9491 u，丢失 47.27% 峰值高度）。

58 实体 17 站点轮廓检验台对比闭式微段线性求交与 48 步二分求根基线（8192 次 14.22 ms vs 25.73 ms，提速 1.81×，误差 3.89e-16），不冒充神经材质生成。
conclusions_en: Across 17 grazing silhouette rays targeting a sharp ridge (H=1.8000 u, half-width w=0.25 u), coarse fixed-step POM ray-marching (Δx=0.40 u, sampling x∈{−0.20, +0.20} u) straddles the crest and causes 9/17 rays to tunnel straight through the peak (collapsing silhouette height to 0.9491 u, a -47.27% loss).

A 2^4=16 dyadic Barycentric Displaced Micro-Mesh (DMM) with closed-form linear segment intersection t*=(y_ray−H_k)/(H_{k+1}−H_k) captures all 17/17 rays (hitting ray 13 y=1.5000 u at x*=−0.0705 u) with 0 tunneled rays and 0.00% crest loss.

The 58-solid 17-station silhouette bench compares closed-form linear micro-segment intersection against 48-step bisection root-finding (14.22 ms vs 25.73 ms at 8,192 passes, 1.81× speedup, 3.89e-16 error) without claiming neural material synthesis.

rounds.title_zh: 屏幕空间接触阴影不留远景墙面假黑晕：有限厚度区间门控与 2.5D 无限深柱选型 FAQ

conclusions_zh: 在正表面深度 z_front=1.00 m、厚度 Δτ=0.25 m（占据 [1.00, 1.25] m）的前景薄柱与远景背景墙组成的 17 站阴影步进测试中，朴素 2.5D 单边判据 z_ray≥z_buf 将薄柱视为延伸至 +∞ 的实心深柱，导致柱体后方空气中的 12/17 条背景光线全部被误涂黑为悬浮假黑晕（第 10 站 z=2.00 m 处 V=0.0）。

58 实体 17 站点接触阴影台对比直接倒数深度门控与 4×4 齐次逆投影矩阵还原基线（8192 次 0.29 ms vs 1.30 ms，提速 4.45×，误差 0），不冒充神经环境光遮蔽。

The 58-solid 17-station contact-shadow bench compares direct reciprocal-Z slab gating against 4×4 inverse-projection unprojection (0.29 ms vs 1.30 ms at 8,192 passes, 4.45× speedup, 0 error) without claiming neural ambient occlusion.

rounds.title_zh: 透视斜面贴图在对角线处不折断不游动：透视正确双曲 (u/w)/(1/w) 插值与屏幕仿射选型 FAQ

The 58-solid 17-station perspective bench compares precomputed vertex (1/w, u/w) interpolation against per-pixel 3D ray-plane intersection (0.46 ms vs 7.89 ms at 8,192 passes, 17.22× speedup, 2.22e-16 error) without claiming neural view warping.

rounds.title_zh: 对称镜像 UV 法线贴图不裂开中线阴阳缝：MikkTSpace 逐像素正交化与手性符号 w 选型 FAQ

The 58-solid 17-station OIT bench compares single-pass commutative WBOIT against per-pixel sorted A-Buffers (1.26 ms vs 22.25 ms at 8,192 passes, 17.64× speedup, 0 error) without claiming neural layer decomposition.
